question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up in the top right corner, enter your email and a password, then confirm your email address from the link we send you.

question: I forgot my password, how can I reset it?
answer: Go to the login page and click Forgot password. Enter your registered email and we'll send you a reset link that's valid for 30 minutes.

question: How do I enroll in a course?
answer: Open the course page and click Enroll Now. If it's a paid course you'll be taken to checkout; free courses give you instant access.

question: Can I get a refund if I don't like a course?
answer: Yes, we offer a full refund within 14 days of purchase as long as you've completed less than 30% of the course. Request it from Settings > Purchases.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, and Apple Pay. All payments are processed securely and we never store your card details.

question: Do I get a certificate after finishing a course?
answer: Yes, you receive a downloadable certificate of completion once you finish all lessons and pass the final quiz with at least 70%.

question: Can I download videos to watch offline?
answer: Yes, the mobile app lets you download lessons for offline viewing. Downloads aren't available on the web version yet.

question: How long do I have access to a course after buying it?
answer: Once purchased, you have lifetime access to the course, including all future updates to its content.

question: The video won't play, what should I do?
answer: Try refreshing the page or switching browsers first. If it still doesn't work, clear your browser cache or try our mobile app instead.

question: How do I contact an instructor with a question?
answer: Use the Q&A tab under any lesson to post your question directly to the instructor and other students taking the course.

question: Can I change my email address?
answer: Yes, go to Settings > Account and update your email. You'll need to verify the new address before the change takes effect.

question: Is there a mobile app?
answer: Yes, our app is available for both iOS and Android. Search for our name in the App Store or Google Play to download it.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Settings > Subscription and click Cancel Plan. You'll keep access until the end of your current billing cycle.

question: Do you offer team or business accounts?
answer: Yes, our Business plan lets you assign courses to a team and track their progress from a shared dashboard. Contact sales for pricing.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: This usually happens when the card has insufficient funds, incorrect billing details, or your bank blocks online payments. Try another card or contact your bank.

question: Can I get an invoice for my purchase?
answer: Yes, invoices are generated automatically and available under Settings > Purchases > Download Invoice.

question: How do I leave a review for a course?
answer: Once you've completed at least 20% of a course, a Leave a Review prompt appears on the course page.

question: Is my personal data safe with you?
answer: Yes, we encrypt your data in transit and at rest, and we never sell your personal information to third parties.

question: Can instructors reply to messages in another language?
answer: Instructors typically reply in the language the course is taught in, but many are happy to help in English as well.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This permanently removes your data and cannot be undone, so make sure to download any certificates first.
